description: This source file implements the TunDeviceController class, managing network interface addresses and routes for a TUN device in a QUIC-based networking environment, including route updates, rule management, and address change callbacks.

classes.name: TunDeviceController
classes.description: Manages network interface addresses and routing rules for a TUN device, including updating addresses, routes, and rules, with support for retries and callbacks.

methods.name: UpdateAddress
methods.description: Updates the network interface address to a desired range, removing old addresses and setting a new one, then triggers callbacks.

methods.name: UpdateRoutes
methods.description: Updates network routes and rules based on desired ranges and routes, removing old rules and adding new ones.

methods.name: UpdateRoutesWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to update routes multiple times with delays between retries.

methods.name: UpdateRules
methods.description: Replaces existing routing rules with new rules for the desired address range.

methods.name: current_address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address of the TUN device.

methods.name: RegisterAddressUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be called when the address is updated.
